map.眨眼次数统计（护眼） 使用指南: Blink Count Statistics (Eye Care) User Guide
map.设定计时窗口（如 60 秒），每次眨眼点一下计数；结束给出单位时间眨眼次数，低于: Set a timing window (say 60 seconds) and tap once per blink; at the end you get blinks per unit time, and a value below the norm suggests blinking more to lubricate the eyes.…
map.成人静息约 15~20 次/分；看屏幕时常降至 1/3，易眼干，仅供参考非诊断。: A resting adult blinks about 15–20 times per minute; screen use often cuts that to a third, which dries the eyes — for reference only, not a diagnosis.
map.不联网，计数与计时均本地进行。: No network involved; both counting and timing run locally.
